stem: One likely reason Mrs. Baird became a successful business owner is that —

options.label: A
options.text: her business allowed her to spend time with her children

options.label: B
options.text: she did not want people to have to make their own bread

options.label: C
options.text: she did not want to work in a restaurant like her husband

options.label: D
options.text: her business involved something that she enjoyed doing
